data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 3.5m was experienced in 2018 (2017: GBP 18.1m surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 1.7m on direct business (2017: GBP 22.5m surplus) and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business (2017: GBP 4.4m deficit).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a GBP 3.5 million surplus in its run-off amount for 2018, indicating a release of prior year claims provisions. This favorable development was composed of a GBP 1.7 million surplus on direct business and a GBP 1.8 million surplus on reinsurance accepted business.
